watch._comment: CPV codes to watch. Edit this list and push — no code changes needed. checkDigit is required for the KIMDIS source (empirically confirmed against the live API, since the EU's own published check-digit formula is known-broken); TED doesn't need it. Full CPV list: https://simap.ted.europa.eu/web/simap/cpv
watch._noiseNote: 72000000 and 72224000 are the two biggest sources of irrelevant hits (hardware procurement, audits, construction, generic consulting frameworks riding along as a minor tag on a big multi-code notice) - kept anyway because removing them loses far more true positives than false ones. 72224000 specifically is project-management/advisory work, not coding - drop it if you only want build work.
